id: \rMina: Ah... sorry, got distracted. What do you need?
en: \rMina: Ah... sorry, got distracted. What do you need?
it: \rMina: Ah... scusa, mi sono distratta. Di cosa hai bisogno?

id: \bSamson: Surprised to see me? Your principal isn't going to sit back and miss this.
en: \bSamson: Surprised to see me? Your principal isn't going to sit back and miss this.
it: \bSamson: Sorpreso di vedermi? Il tuo preside non se ne starà certo con le mani in mano a perdersi tutto questo.

id: \rOlivia: I'm a referree. I hope to see you advance.
en: \rOlivia: I'm a referree. I hope to see you advance.
it: \rOlivia: Sono un'arbitra. Spero di vederti passare il turno.

id: \rLana: I bet the first round will be tough.
en: \rLana: I bet the first round will be tough.
it: \rSuiren: Scommetto che il primo turno sarà difficile.
\bJames: Quale dovrebbe essere il nostro piano?

id: \bFaba: Hmm, a Battle Royal. I'll need a good strategy to move on.
en: \bFaba: Hmm, a Battle Royal. I'll need a good strategy to move on.
it: \bVicio: Mmh, un Battle Royal. Mi servirà una buona strategia per andare avanti.

id: \bFaba: No hard feelings, but I'm going to have to crush you. The prize is too good to pass up.
en: \bFaba: No hard feelings, but I'm going to have to crush you. The prize is too good to pass up.
it: \bVicio: Senza rancore, ma dovrò stracciarti. Il premio è troppo allettante per lasciarselo sfuggire.

id: \bI guess I wanted to see you win.
en: \bI guess I wanted to see you win.

id: \bNanu: I got dragged into this. Still, maybe it will be worth a watch.
en: \bNanu: I got dragged into this. Still, maybe it will be worth a watch.
it: \bNanu: Mi ci hanno trascinato. Comunque, forse varrà la pena guardare.

id: \bHau: Haha, you're here. Time for that rematch, isn't it?
en: \bHau: Haha, you're here. Time for that rematch, isn't it?
it: \bHau: Ahah, sei qui. È ora di quella rivincita, no?

id: \rAcerola: Ah, you're here too. Should have guessed.
en: \rAcerola: Ah, you're here too. Should have guessed.
it: \rAcerola: Ah, ci sei anche tu. Avrei dovuto immaginarlo.

id: \bKukui: Welcome, everyone, to the very first Alola League. The winner of this will become Alola's very own champion.
en: \bKukui: Welcome, everyone, to the very first Alola League. The winner of this will become Alola's very own champion.
it: \bKukui: Benvenuti a tutti alla primissima Lega di Alola. Il vincitore diventerà il Campione di Alola.

id: \bBut to do that you have to get through the first round. Defeat everyone you see and be one of the last 16 remaining to move on to the next round.
en: \bBut to do that you have to get through the first round. Defeat everyone you see and be one of the last 16 remaining to move on to the next round.
it: \bMa per farlo dovete superare il primo turno. Sconfiggete chiunque incontriate e restate tra gli ultimi 16 per passare al turno successivo.

id: \bKukui: That's it! We have our top 16. Everyone, please exit the stage.
en: \bKukui: That's it! We have our top 16. Everyone, please exit the stage.
it: \bKukui: Ecco fatto! Abbiamo i nostri 16 finalisti. Tutti gli altri, per favore, lascino il palco.

id: \bCongratulations on advancing to the Top 16.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
en: \bCongratulations on advancing to the Top 16.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
it: \bCongratulazioni per essere entrato tra i migliori 16.\nLa tua prossima lotta si terrà sulla destra.

id: \rHapu: It's a good thing I'm not competing. You'd be in trouble.
en: \rHapu: It's a good thing I'm not competing. You'd be in trouble.
it: \rHapu: Meno male che io non partecipo. Saresti nei guai.

id: \bGladion: So, you made it, /PN? Good. I was afraid this was going to be too easy.
en: \bGladion: So, you made it, /PN? Good. I was afraid this was going to be too easy.
it: \bIridio: Allora ce l'hai fatta, /PN? Bene. Temevo che sarebbe stato troppo facile.

id: \bMy family honor is on the line.
en: \bMy family honor is on the line.
it: \bÈ in gioco l'onore della mia famiglia.

id: \b:Ilima: This isn't the Kalos League, but it looks promising.
en: \b:Ilima: This isn't the Kalos League, but it looks promising.
it: \b:Ilima: Non è la Lega di Kalos, ma promette bene.

id: \bSophocles: There's so much to consider. What should I do?
en: \bSophocles: There's so much to consider. What should I do?
it: \bChrys: Ci sono così tante cose da considerare. Cosa dovrei fare?

id: \rYou know, you could have avoided me.
en: \rYou know, you could have avoided me.

it: \rMi sa che mi limiterò a guardare.

id: \bKiawe: I need to get in some extra training.
en: \bKiawe: I need to get in some extra training.
it: \bKiawe: Devo fare un po' di allenamento extra.

id: \rLillie: I hope I make it through the first round. I hope you do too!
en: \rLillie: I hope I make it through the first round. I hope you do too!
it: \rLylia: Spero di superare il primo turno. E spero che ce la faccia anche tu!

id: \rSorry, but I have to stop you.
en: \rSorry, but I have to stop you.

id: \bHala: I'm one of the referees. Good luck to you.
en: \bHala: I'm one of the referees. Good luck to you.
it: \bHala: Sono uno degli arbitri. Buona fortuna.
